audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for Judah's surety, Benjamin's descent, double silver, Joseph's house, brotherly seating, and Benjamin's favored portion.

verses.restored: The famine was heavy in the land.

familiar.text: And the famine was sore in the land.

modern.text: Now the famine was still severe in the land.

original.text: וְהָרָעָ֖ב כָּבֵ֥ד בָּאָֽרֶץ

verses.restored: When they had finished eating the grain they had brought from Egypt, their father said, Return, buy us a little food.

familiar.text: And it came to pass, when they had eaten up the corn which they had brought out of Egypt, their father said unto them, Go again, buy us a little food.

modern.text: So when Jacob’s sons had eaten all the grain they had brought from Egypt, their father said to them, “Go back and buy us a little more food.”

original.text: וַיְהִ֗י כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר כִּלּוּ֙ לֶאֱכֹ֣ל אֶת הַשֶּׁ֔בֶר אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֵבִ֖יאוּ מִמִּצְרָ֑יִם וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם֙ אֲבִיהֶ֔ם שֻׁ֖בוּ שִׁבְרוּ לָ֥נוּ מְעַט אֹֽכֶל

verses.restored: Judah spoke to him, saying, The man solemnly warned us, saying, You shall not see my face unless your brother is with you.

familiar.text: And Judah spake unto him, saying, The man did solemnly protest unto us, saying, Ye shall not see my face, except your brother be with you.

modern.text: But Judah replied, “The man solemnly warned us, ‘You will not see my face again unless your brother is with you.’

original.text: וַיֹּ֧אמֶר אֵלָ֛יו יְהוּדָ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר הָעֵ֣ד הֵעִד֩ בָּ֨נוּ הָאִ֤ישׁ לֵאמֹר֙ לֹֽא תִרְא֣וּ פָנַ֔י בִּלְתִּ֖י אֲחִיכֶ֥ם אִתְּכֶֽם

verses.restored: If you send our brother with us, we will go down and buy food for you.

familiar.text: If thou wilt send our brother with us, we will go down and buy thee food:

modern.text: If you will send our brother with us, we will go down and buy food for you.

original.text: אִם יֶשְׁךָ֛ מְשַׁלֵּ֥חַ אֶת אָחִ֖ינוּ אִתָּ֑נוּ נֵרְדָ֕ה וְנִשְׁבְּרָ֥ה לְךָ֖ אֹֽכֶל

verses.restored: But if you do not send him, we will not go down, for the man said to us, You shall not see my face unless your brother is with you.

familiar.text: But if thou wilt not send him, we will not go down: for the man said unto us, Ye shall not see my face, except your brother be with you.

modern.text: But if you will not send him, we will not go; for the man told us, ‘You will not see my face again unless your brother is with you.’”

original.text: וְאִם אֵינְךָ֥ מְשַׁלֵּ֖חַ לֹ֣א נֵרֵ֑ד כִּֽי הָאִ֞ישׁ אָמַ֤ר אֵלֵ֨ינוּ֙ לֹֽא תִרְא֣וּ פָנַ֔י בִּלְתִּ֖י אֲחִיכֶ֥ם אִתְּכֶֽם

verses.restored: Israel said, Why did you do harm to me by telling the man you had another brother?

familiar.text: And Israel said, Wherefore dealt ye so ill with me, as to tell the man whether ye had yet a brother?

modern.text: “Why did you bring this trouble upon me?” Israel asked. “Why did you tell the man you had another brother?”

original.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לָמָ֥ה הֲרֵעֹתֶ֖ם לִ֑י לְהַגִּ֣יד לָאִ֔ישׁ הַע֥וֹד לָכֶ֖ם אָֽח

verses.restored: They said, The man asked closely about us and our kindred, saying, Is your father still alive? Do you have a brother? We told him according to these words. Could we know that he would say, Bring your brother down?

familiar.text: And they said, The man asked us straitly of our state, and of our kindred, saying, Is your father yet alive? have ye another brother? and we told him according to the tenor of these words: could we certainly know that he would say, Bring your brother down?

modern.text: They replied, “The man questioned us in detail about ourselves and our family: ‘Is your father still alive? Do you have another brother?’ And we answered him accordingly. How could we possibly know that he would say, ‘Bring your brother here’?”

original.text: וַיֹּאמְר֡וּ שָׁא֣וֹל שָֽׁאַל הָ֠אִישׁ לָ֣נוּ וּלְמֽוֹלַדְתֵּ֜נוּ לֵאמֹ֗ר הַע֨וֹד אֲבִיכֶ֥ם חַי֙ הֲיֵ֣שׁ לָכֶ֣ם אָ֔ח וַנַ֨גֶּד ל֔וֹ עַל פִּ֖י הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֑לֶּה הֲיָד֣וֹעַ נֵדַ֔ע כִּ֣י יֹאמַ֔ר הוֹרִ֖ידוּ אֶת אֲחִיכֶֽם

verses.restored: Judah said to Israel his father, Send the boy with me, and we will rise and go, so that we may live and not die, both we, you, and our little ones.

familiar.text: And Judah said unto Israel his father, Send the lad with me, and we will arise and go; that we may live, and not die, both we, and thou, and also our little ones.

modern.text: And Judah said to his father Israel, “Send the boy with me, and we will go at once, so that we may live and not die—neither we, nor you, nor our children.

original.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוּדָ֜ה אֶל יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל אָבִ֗יו שִׁלְחָ֥ה הַנַּ֛עַר אִתִּ֖י וְנָק֣וּמָה וְנֵלֵ֑כָה וְנִֽחְיֶה֙ וְלֹ֣א נָמ֔וּת גַּם אֲנַ֥חְנוּ גַם אַתָּ֖ה גַּם טַפֵּֽנוּ

verses.restored: I myself will be surety for him; from my hand you may require him. If I do not bring him back to you and set him before your face, I will bear the blame before you all the days.

familiar.text: I will be surety for him; of my hand shalt thou require him: if I bring him not unto thee, and set him before thee, then let me bear the blame for ever:

modern.text: I will guarantee his safety. You may hold me personally responsible. If I do not bring him back and set him before you, then may I bear the guilt before you all my life.

original.text: אָֽנֹכִי֙ אֶֽעֶרְבֶ֔נּוּ מִיָּדִ֖י תְּבַקְשֶׁ֑נּוּ אִם לֹ֨א הֲבִיאֹתִ֤יו אֵלֶ֨יךָ֙ וְהִצַּגְתִּ֣יו לְפָנֶ֔יךָ וְחָטָ֥אתִֽי לְךָ֖ כָּל הַיָּמִֽים

verses.restored: If we had not delayed, surely by now we could have returned twice.

familiar.text: For except we had lingered, surely now we had returned this second time.

modern.text: If we had not delayed, we could have come and gone twice by now.”

original.text: כִּ֖י לוּלֵ֣א הִתְמַהְמָ֑הְנוּ כִּֽי עַתָּ֥ה שַׁ֖בְנוּ זֶ֥ה פַעֲמָֽיִם

verses.restored: Israel their father said to them, If it must be so, do this: take from the choice produce of the land in your vessels and bring a gift down to the man: a little balm, a little honey, spices, myrrh, pistachios, and almonds.

familiar.text: And their father Israel said unto them, If it must be so now, do this; take of the best fruits in the land in your vessels, and carry down the man a present, a little balm, and a little honey, spices, and myrrh, nuts, and almonds:

modern.text: Then their father Israel said to them, “If it must be so, then do this: Put some of the best products of the land in your packs and carry them down as a gift for the man—a little balm and a little honey, spices and myrrh, pistachios and almonds.

original.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֜ם יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל אֲבִיהֶ֗ם אִם כֵּ֣ן אֵפוֹא֮ זֹ֣את עֲשׂוּ֒ קְח֞וּ מִזִּמְרַ֤ת הָאָ֨רֶץ֙ בִּכְלֵיכֶ֔ם וְהוֹרִ֥ידוּ לָאִ֖ישׁ מִנְחָ֑ה מְעַ֤ט צֳרִי֙ וּמְעַ֣ט דְּבַ֔שׁ נְכֹ֣את וָלֹ֔ט בָּטְנִ֖ים וּשְׁקֵדִֽים

verses.restored: Take double silver in your hand, and the silver returned in the mouth of your sacks you shall return in your hand; perhaps it was a mistake.

familiar.text: And take double money in your hand; and the money that was brought again in the mouth of your sacks, carry it again in your hand; peradventure it was an oversight:

modern.text: Take double the silver with you so that you may return the silver that was put back into the mouths of your sacks. Perhaps it was a mistake.

original.text: וְכֶ֥סֶף מִשְׁנֶ֖ה קְח֣וּ בְיֶדְכֶ֑ם וְאֶת הַכֶּ֜סֶף הַמּוּשָׁ֨ב בְּפִ֤י אַמְתְּחֹֽתֵיכֶם֙ תָּשִׁ֣יבוּ בְיֶדְכֶ֔ם אוּלַ֥י מִשְׁגֶּ֖ה הֽוּא

verses.restored: Take your brother also, rise, and return to the man.

familiar.text: Take also your brother, and arise, go again unto the man:

modern.text: Take your brother as well, and return to the man at once.

original.text: וְאֶת אֲחִיכֶ֖ם קָ֑חוּ וְק֖וּמוּ שׁ֥וּבוּ אֶל הָאִֽישׁ

verses.restored: May El Shaddai give you compassion before the man, so that he may release your other brother and Benjamin. As for me, if I am bereaved, I am bereaved.

familiar.text: And God Almighty give you mercy before the man, that he may send away your other brother, and Benjamin. If I be bereaved of my children, I am bereaved.

modern.text: May God Almighty grant you mercy before the man, that he may release your other brother along with Benjamin. As for me, if I am bereaved, I am bereaved.”

original.text: וְאֵ֣ל שַׁדַּ֗י יִתֵּ֨ן לָכֶ֤ם רַחֲמִים֙ לִפְנֵ֣י הָאִ֔ישׁ וְשִׁלַּ֥ח לָכֶ֛ם אֶת אֲחִיכֶ֥ם אַחֵ֖ר וְאֶת בִּנְיָמִ֑ין וַאֲנִ֕י כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁכֹ֖לְתִּי שָׁכָֽלְתִּי

verses.restored: The men took this gift, double silver in their hand, and Benjamin; they rose, went down to Egypt, and stood before Joseph.

familiar.text: And the men took that present, and they took double money in their hand, and Benjamin; and rose up, and went down to Egypt, and stood before Joseph.

modern.text: So the men took these gifts, along with double the amount of silver, and Benjamin as well. Then they hurried down to Egypt and stood before Joseph. Joseph’s Hospitality to His Brothers

original.text: וַיִּקְח֤וּ הָֽאֲנָשִׁים֙ אֶת הַמִּנְחָ֣ה הַזֹּ֔את וּמִשְׁנֶה כֶּ֛סֶף לָקְח֥וּ בְיָדָ֖ם וְאֶת בִּנְיָמִ֑ן וַיָּקֻ֨מוּ֙ וַיֵּרְד֣וּ מִצְרַ֔יִם וַיַּֽעַמְד֖וּ לִפְנֵ֥י יוֹסֵֽף

verses.restored: Joseph saw Benjamin with them and said to the one over his house, Bring the men into the house, slaughter an animal, and prepare, for the men shall eat with me at noon.

familiar.text: And when Joseph saw Benjamin with them, he said to the ruler of his house, Bring these men home, and slay, and make ready; for these men shall dine with me at noon.

modern.text: When Joseph saw Benjamin with his brothers, he said to the steward of his house, “Take these men to my house. Slaughter an animal and prepare it, for they shall dine with me at noon.”

original.text: וַיַּ֨רְא יוֹסֵ֣ף אִתָּם֮ אֶת בִּנְיָמִין֒ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר֙ לַֽאֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל בֵּית֔וֹ הָבֵ֥א אֶת הָאֲנָשִׁ֖ים הַבָּ֑יְתָה וּטְבֹ֤חַ טֶ֨בַח֙ וְהָכֵ֔ן כִּ֥י אִתִּ֛י יֹאכְל֥וּ הָאֲנָשִׁ֖ים בַּֽצָּהֳרָֽיִם

verses.restored: The man did as Joseph said and brought the men into Joseph’s house.

familiar.text: And the man did as Joseph bade; and the man brought the men into Joseph’s house.

modern.text: The man did as Joseph had commanded and took the brothers to Joseph’s house.

original.text: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ הָאִ֔ישׁ כַּֽאֲשֶׁ֖ר אָמַ֣ר יוֹסֵ֑ף וַיָּבֵ֥א הָאִ֛ישׁ אֶת הָאֲנָשִׁ֖ים בֵּ֥יתָה יוֹסֵֽף

verses.restored: The men were afraid because they were brought into Joseph’s house. They said, Because of the silver returned in our sacks at first we are being brought in, to roll himself upon us, fall upon us, and take us as servants with our donkeys.

familiar.text: And the men were afraid, because they were brought into Joseph’s house; and they said, Because of the money that was returned in our sacks at the first time are we brought in; that he may seek occasion against us, and fall upon us, and take us for bondmen, and our asses.

modern.text: But the brothers were frightened that they had been taken to Joseph’s house. “We have been brought here because of the silver that was returned in our bags the first time,” they said. “They intend to overpower us and take us as slaves, along with our donkeys.”

original.text: וַיִּֽירְא֣וּ הָֽאֲנָשִׁ֗ים כִּ֣י הֽוּבְאוּ֮ בֵּ֣ית יוֹסֵף֒ וַיֹּאמְר֗וּ עַל דְּבַ֤ר הַכֶּ֨סֶף֙ הַשָּׁ֤ב בְּאַמְתְּחֹתֵ֨ינוּ֙ בַּתְּחִלָּ֔ה אֲנַ֖חְנוּ מֽוּבָאִ֑ים לְהִתְגֹּלֵ֤ל עָלֵ֨ינוּ֙ וּלְהִתְנַפֵּ֣ל עָלֵ֔ינוּ וְלָקַ֧חַת אֹתָ֛נוּ לַעֲבָדִ֖ים וְאֶת חֲמֹרֵֽינוּ

verses.restored: They came near to the man over Joseph’s house and spoke to him at the entrance of the house.

familiar.text: And they came near to the steward of Joseph’s house, and they communed with him at the door of the house,

modern.text: So they approached Joseph’s steward and spoke to him at the entrance to the house.

original.text: וַֽיִּגְּשׁוּ֙ אֶל הָאִ֔ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל בֵּ֣ית יוֹסֵ֑ף וַיְדַבְּר֥וּ אֵלָ֖יו פֶּ֥תַח הַבָּֽיִת

verses.restored: They said, Please, my lord, we indeed came down at first to buy food.

familiar.text: And said, O sir, we came indeed down at the first time to buy food:

modern.text: “Please, sir,” they said, “we really did come down here the first time to buy food.

original.text: וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ בִּ֣י אֲדֹנִ֑י יָרֹ֥ד יָרַ֛דְנוּ בַּתְּחִלָּ֖ה לִשְׁבָּר אֹֽכֶל

verses.restored: When we came to the lodging place and opened our sacks, look, each man’s silver was in the mouth of his sack, our silver in full weight, and we have brought it back in our hand.

familiar.text: And it came to pass, when we came to the inn, that we opened our sacks, and, behold, every man’s money was in the mouth of his sack, our money in full weight: and we have brought it again in our hand.

modern.text: But when we came to the place we lodged for the night, we opened our sacks and, behold, each of us found his silver in the mouth of his sack! It was the full amount of our silver, and we have brought it back with us.

original.text: וַֽיְהִ֞י כִּי בָ֣אנוּ אֶל הַמָּל֗וֹן וַֽנִּפְתְּחָה֙ אֶת אַמְתְּחֹתֵ֔ינוּ וְהִנֵּ֤ה כֶֽסֶף אִישׁ֙ בְּפִ֣י אַמְתַּחְתּ֔וֹ כַּסְפֵּ֖נוּ בְּמִשְׁקָל֑וֹ וַנָּ֥שֶׁב אֹת֖וֹ בְּיָדֵֽנוּ

verses.restored: Other silver we have brought down in our hand to buy food. We do not know who put our silver in our sacks.

familiar.text: And other money have we brought down in our hands to buy food: we cannot tell who put our money in our sacks.

modern.text: We have brought additional silver with us to buy food. We do not know who put our silver in our sacks.”

original.text: וְכֶ֧סֶף אַחֵ֛ר הוֹרַ֥דְנוּ בְיָדֵ֖נוּ לִשְׁבָּר אֹ֑כֶל לֹ֣א יָדַ֔עְנוּ מִי שָׂ֥ם כַּסְפֵּ֖נוּ בְּאַמְתְּחֹתֵֽינוּ

verses.restored: He said, Peace to you; do not fear. Your Divine and the Divine of your father gave you treasure in your sacks; your silver came to me. Then he brought Simeon out to them.

familiar.text: And he said, Peace be to you, fear not: your God, and the God of your father, hath given you treasure in your sacks: I had your money. And he brought Simeon out unto them.

modern.text: “It is fine,” said the steward. “Do not be afraid. Your God, the God of your father, gave you the treasure that was in your sacks. I received your silver.” Then he brought Simeon out to them.

original.text: וַיֹּאמֶר֩ שָׁל֨וֹם לָכֶ֜ם אַל תִּירָ֗אוּ אֱלֹ֨הֵיכֶ֜ם וֵֽאלֹהֵ֤י אֲבִיכֶם֙ נָתַ֨ן לָכֶ֤ם מַטְמוֹן֙ בְּאַמְתְּחֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם כַּסְפְּכֶ֖ם בָּ֣א אֵלָ֑י וַיּוֹצֵ֥א אֲלֵהֶ֖ם אֶת שִׁמְעֽוֹן

verses.restored: The man brought the men into Joseph’s house, gave water, and they washed their feet; he gave feed to their donkeys.

familiar.text: And the man brought the men into Joseph’s house, and gave them water, and they washed their feet; and he gave their asses provender.

modern.text: And the steward took the men into Joseph’s house, gave them water to wash their feet, and provided food for their donkeys.

original.text: וַיָּבֵ֥א הָאִ֛ישׁ אֶת הָאֲנָשִׁ֖ים בֵּ֣יתָה יוֹסֵ֑ף וַיִּתֶּן מַ֨יִם֙ וַיִּרְחֲצ֣וּ רַגְלֵיהֶ֔ם וַיִּתֵּ֥ן מִסְפּ֖וֹא לַחֲמֹֽרֵיהֶֽם

verses.restored: They prepared the gift for Joseph’s coming at noon, for they heard they would eat bread there.

familiar.text: And they made ready the present against Joseph came at noon: for they heard that they should eat bread there.

modern.text: Since the brothers had been told that they were going to eat a meal there, they prepared their gift for Joseph’s arrival at noon.

original.text: וַיָּכִ֨ינוּ֙ אֶת הַמִּנְחָ֔ה עַד בּ֥וֹא יוֹסֵ֖ף בַּֽצָּהֳרָ֑יִם כִּ֣י שָֽׁמְע֔וּ כִּי שָׁ֖ם יֹ֥אכְלוּ לָֽחֶם

verses.restored: When Joseph came home, they brought him the gift in their hand into the house and bowed down to him to the ground.

familiar.text: And when Joseph came home, they brought him the present which was in their hand into the house, and bowed themselves to him to the earth.

modern.text: When Joseph came home, they presented him with the gifts they had brought, and they bowed to the ground before him.

original.text: וַיָּבֹ֤א יוֹסֵף֙ הַבַּ֔יְתָה וַיָּבִ֥יאּוּ ל֛וֹ אֶת הַמִּנְחָ֥ה אֲשֶׁר בְּיָדָ֖ם הַבָּ֑יְתָה וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ ל֖וֹ אָֽרְצָה

verses.restored: He asked them about peace and said, Is there peace with your aged father of whom you spoke? Is he still alive?

familiar.text: And he asked them of their welfare, and said, Is your father well, the old man of whom ye spake? Is he yet alive?

modern.text: He asked if they were well, and then he asked, “How is your elderly father you told me about? Is he still alive?”

original.text: וַיִּשְׁאַ֤ל לָהֶם֙ לְשָׁל֔וֹם וַיֹּ֗אמֶר הֲשָׁל֛וֹם אֲבִיכֶ֥ם הַזָּקֵ֖ן אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֲמַרְתֶּ֑ם הַעוֹדֶ֖נּוּ חָֽי

verses.restored: They said, There is peace with your servant our father; he is still alive. They bowed and prostrated themselves.

familiar.text: And they answered, Thy servant our father is in good health, he is yet alive. And they bowed down their heads, and made obeisance.

modern.text: “Your servant our father is well,” they answered. “He is still alive.” And they bowed down to honor him.

original.text: וַיֹּאמְר֗וּ שָׁל֛וֹם לְעַבְדְּךָ֥ לְאָבִ֖ינוּ עוֹדֶ֣נּוּ חָ֑י וַֽיִּקְּד֖וּ וישתחו

verses.restored: He lifted his eyes and saw Benjamin his brother, his mother’s son, and said, Is this your youngest brother of whom you spoke to me? He said, May the Divine be gracious to you, my son.

familiar.text: And he lifted up his eyes, and saw his brother Benjamin, his mother’s son, and said, Is this your younger brother, of whom ye spake unto me? And he said, God be gracious unto thee, my son.

modern.text: When Joseph looked up and saw his brother Benjamin, his own mother’s son, he asked, “Is this your youngest brother, the one you told me about?” Then he declared, “May God be gracious to you, my son.”

original.text: וַיִּשָּׂ֣א עֵינָ֗יו וַיַּ֞רְא אֶת בִּנְיָמִ֣ין אָחִיו֮ בֶּן אִמּוֹ֒ וַיֹּ֗אמֶר הֲזֶה֙ אֲחִיכֶ֣ם הַקָּטֹ֔ן אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲמַרְתֶּ֖ם אֵלָ֑י וַיֹּאמַ֕ר אֱלֹהִ֥ים יָחְנְךָ֖ בְּנִֽי

verses.restored: Joseph hurried, for his compassion grew warm toward his brother, and he sought a place to weep. He entered the chamber and wept there.

familiar.text: And Joseph made haste; for his bowels did yearn upon his brother: and he sought where to weep; and he entered into his chamber, and wept there.

modern.text: Joseph hurried out because he was moved to tears for his brother, and he went to a private room to weep.

original.text: וַיְמַהֵ֣ר יוֹסֵ֗ף כִּֽי נִכְמְר֤וּ רַחֲמָיו֙ אֶל אָחִ֔יו וַיְבַקֵּ֖שׁ לִבְכּ֑וֹת וַיָּבֹ֥א הַחַ֖דְרָה וַיֵּ֥בְךְּ שָֽׁמָּה

verses.restored: He washed his face, came out, restrained himself, and said, Set out bread.

familiar.text: And he washed his face, and went out, and refrained himself, and said, Set on bread.

modern.text: Then he washed his face and came back out. Regaining his composure, he said, “Serve the meal.”

original.text: וַיִּרְחַ֥ץ פָּנָ֖יו וַיֵּצֵ֑א וַיִּ֨תְאַפַּ֔ק וַיֹּ֖אמֶר שִׂ֥ימוּ לָֽחֶם

verses.restored: They set out for him by himself, for them by themselves, and for the Egyptians eating with him by themselves, because Egyptians could not eat bread with Hebrews, for that is an abomination to Egypt.

familiar.text: And they set on for him by himself, and for them by themselves, and for the Egyptians, which did eat with him, by themselves: because the Egyptians might not eat bread with the Hebrews; for that is an abomination unto the Egyptians.

modern.text: They separately served Joseph, his brothers, and the Egyptians. They ate separately because the Egyptians would not eat with the Hebrews, since that was detestable to them.

original.text: וַיָּשִׂ֥ימוּ ל֛וֹ לְבַדּ֖וֹ וְלָהֶ֣ם לְבַדָּ֑ם וְלַמִּצְרִ֞ים הָאֹכְלִ֤ים אִתּוֹ֙ לְבַדָּ֔ם כִּי֩ לֹ֨א יוּכְל֜וּן הַמִּצְרִ֗ים לֶאֱכֹ֤ל אֶת הָֽעִבְרִים֙ לֶ֔חֶם כִּי תוֹעֵבָ֥ה הִ֖וא לְמִצְרָֽיִם

verses.restored: They sat before him, the firstborn according to his firstborn status and the youngest according to his youth, and the men looked at one another in astonishment.

familiar.text: And they sat before him, the firstborn according to his birthright, and the youngest according to his youth: and the men marvelled one at another.

modern.text: They were seated before Joseph in order by age, from the firstborn to the youngest, and the men looked at one another in astonishment.

original.text: וַיֵּשְׁב֣וּ לְפָנָ֔יו הַבְּכֹר֙ כִּבְכֹ֣רָת֔וֹ וְהַצָּעִ֖יר כִּצְעִרָת֑וֹ וַיִּתְמְה֥וּ הָאֲנָשִׁ֖ים אִ֥ישׁ אֶל רֵעֵֽהוּ

verses.restored: Portions were carried to them from before him, but Benjamin’s portion was five times greater than any of theirs. They drank and became merry with him.

familiar.text: And he took and sent messes unto them from before him: but Benjamin’s mess was five times so much as any of theirs. And they drank, and were merry with him.

modern.text: When the portions were served to them from Joseph’s table, Benjamin’s portion was five times larger than any of the others. So they feasted and drank freely with Joseph.

original.text: וַיִּשָּׂ֨א מַשְׂאֹ֜ת מֵאֵ֣ת פָּנָיו֮ אֲלֵהֶם֒ וַתֵּ֜רֶב מַשְׂאַ֧ת בִּנְיָמִ֛ן מִמַּשְׂאֹ֥ת כֻּלָּ֖ם חָמֵ֣שׁ יָד֑וֹת וַיִּשְׁתּ֥וּ וַֽיִּשְׁכְּר֖וּ עִמּֽוֹ
